title: Cite catalog records from roadmap items
lead: A roadmap item stores an ordered list of catalog ids. The citation is a reference: it does not block, rescore, or change `slicer next`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** TUI browsing, `slicer find` over records, outline import of records, purging records, citations from one record to another beyond the successor, and any queue effect.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A record that nothing can point at is a second document. The slice that serves a goal, or rests on an assumption, should name it, and a retired assumption or decision should stay visible on that slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ops.py` and `src/slicer/cli.py` gain `catalog cite` and `catalog uncite`.
- `src/slicer/verify.py` reports a cite that names nothing.
- `src/slicer/render.py` adds the slice Cites line and the roadmap-row callout.
- `src/slicer/cli.py` `show` resolves citations.
- `src/slicer/ai.py`, the installed skill text, `docs/agents.md`, `docs/commands.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `README.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Tests for cite, uncite, show, render, and verify.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
```
slicer catalog cite S01 C01 C02
slicer catalog uncite S01 C01
```

`cite` appends ids, skips ones already present, and writes nothing when nothing changed. `uncite` of an id the item does not cite fails. Either command refuses the whole request before writing when any id is unknown. `slicer show` includes each citation's id, kind, title, status, reason, and successor. `slicer catalog show` includes `cited_by` in queue order, including done and retired items.

A slice header gains a `Cites:` line only when the list is nonempty. Each entry is `C01 goal: title`. A retired assumption or decision adds `(retired)`. The roadmap table gains no column. A row that cites a retired assumption or decision appends `retired assumption C02` or `retired decision C04` the same way `discovered from` is joined. Other retired kinds do not change the row.

`check` fails when a cite names nothing. `cites` stays an atomic list in the index merge, like `depends_on`. History actions are `cite` and `uncite` on the item id.

Agent instructions say that `slicer goals` returns the prose plus goal and non-goal records, and `slicer catalog` is how the other four kinds are read.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`. `slicer check` passes. `git diff --check` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Implement on a worktree branched from the catalog slice after that slice is on main. Do not commit, merge, or push until the owner asks. This repo finishes with `handoff`.
